compatibility: From slot 11431, scheduled six-node disconnected DAG cells redirect to connected moderate DAGs (concentric redirects to grid/staggered/radial). This explicit staged feasibility revision follows 15000 isomorphism-rejected candidates at that cell; accepted prefix, exact size quotas and split memberships are preserved. Earlier disconnected DAG coverage remains; no disconnected-count quota is claimed.

Trials 0–999 retain the original eight geometry templates; trials 1000–4999 use eight additional templates, with n−1 outer-ring nodes for small concentric layouts. Trials >=5000 add a six-node concentric isolated pocket: four outer nodes, a center and an offset inner node; core corridors are prioritized before pocket corridors and disconnected cells isolate the pocket. Quality thresholds are unchanged.
Radial and concentric layouts normally use sparse bins to preserve separated corridors; six-node cyclic graphs use moderate density to avoid exhausting sparse cycle topologies.
Six-node cyclic graphs are connected and moderate; sparse/disconnected cycle cells have insufficient distinct base topologies under the corridor constraints.
Six-node cyclic graphs exclude concentric: its seven available corridors cannot meet the eight-edge moderate minimum and reserve an addition.
Six/seven-node disconnected graphs use sparse bins; capacities and explicit missing cells are reported.
Base graphs must be unique up to isomorphism across all groups. Every variant is compared across splits and against history; same-split descendant-only overlap is allowed and counted separately.
No reciprocal or parallel edges; crossings are non-junctions and rejected in this release.
All layouts support DAG/cyclic and weakly connected/disconnected graphs subject to constructive pool feasibility.
Appearance is scheduled independently of semantic streams; chance correlations must be reported.
Question pairs and primary edits enforce mixed relevance; no fully balanced Cartesian product is claimed.
historical_retention: 0 retained: new minimum 1152-pixel canvas and 26-pixel text exclude all 800-pixel/22-pixel historical renderings; historical graph variants are additionally blacklisted by exact isomorphism.
split_policy: 70/15/15, exact per-size cumulative rounding; no historical graph enters the new test set; no layout/style holdout claim
